requirements_source.provided_content: Title: Calculator - GHCP — Requirements_Test_1. User story: As a user, calculate square root of a number to obtain results without manual calculation. FR1: provide √ button and compute valid nonnegative values. FR2: accept positive integers, positive decimals, and zero. FR3: display result with up to configured decimal precision (example 8 decimal places). FR4: for negative input display exactly 'Invalid input. Square root of a negative number is not supported.'; app must not crash or freeze. FR5: replace current display value and show result immediately. FR6: allow operation result in subsequent calculations. NFR1: complete within 1 second. NFR2: mathematically accurate to supported precision. NFR3: button clearly labeled √ and accessible via mouse/touch.
